item.title: Robert Irwin flying flags supporting those suffering endometriosis
item.description:
Robert Irwin in 2024 sharing why men deserve to care about endometriosis, a disease that doesn't directly afflict many males.
Bindi Irwin posting about her journey with endometriosis. Why should men care about female physiology? Well, not only does half the population experience menstruation, menopause, endometriosis risks, the other (nearly) half of the population is attracted to women, sons of women, brothers of women, fathers of women. Guys can ask about women's topics to their mothers, sisters, partners, friends. Makes us a better person to be aware of others around us, especially those we care about.

item.title: They know they're losing youth
item.description: Ronny Chieng on The Daily Show responding to JD Vance begging Gen Z to embrace the rot. Two asides: this is why repugnants target disaffected youth; those that feel they are dating failures, career failures, academic failures, that are not engaged with community. Also, I remember seeing 2024 when propaganda bots would downvoted and comment to keep politics off Imgur, that they're only here for kiddies and tiddies. There's a ton of politics in regular rotation now. Keeping people apprised with the speed of social media is important when the house is on fire and half the denizens are pro-gasoline. Brava

If the world were merely seductive, that would be easy. It it were merely challenging, that would be no problem. But I arise in the morning torn between a desire to improve the world and a desire to enjoy the world. This makes it hard to plan the day. -E.B. White, writer (1899-1985) So, I made a discord server. It's a relaxed environment where you can take/donate memes to the cause, play trivia twice a week, chat about lots of topics or about nothing at all. We also have Jack Box game night and are setting up movie night! Very laid back/relaxed vibe. Come hang with us. https://discord.gg/AWFV7FT3RQ I'm also on the imgcat server for updates & fun: https://discord.gg/TpjD37jgJ9 https://ko-fi.com/mememuseumcurator Unable to work, zero income. Feel free to leave me a tip. Those that have, y'all are the bee's knees. You've honestly been my lifeline. item.title: This is a photo of my family with a young Dolly Parton taken in 1967
item.description: Dolly was part of a concert near Andrew AFB in Maryland then, and my (military) family attended. We were blessed with the opportunity to meet and talk with her. She was as true and sweet then as she was until her passing today. The world's light is much more dim without her. Thank you for the many, many incredible memories you gave my family throughout or lifetimes. Rest in Peace Dolly.
